fax.description: Replacement fax text; empty clears it.

functions.name: update-task
functions.description: Partially update a task's title, description, assignment, affiliation, priority, scheduled dates, or remaining work, returning the updated task. This does not move the task or progress its status.

taskId.description: Opaque identifier of the task to update within this deployment.

dueAt.description: Replacement due instant with whole seconds and an explicit UTC marker or numeric offset; omission preserves the due time.

title.description: Replacement task name as ordinary Unicode text.

managerId.description: Opaque staff identifier for the manager; omission preserves the current manager.

assigneeId.description: Opaque staff identifier to assign to the task; omission preserves the current assignee.

priorityId.description: Opaque replacement task priority identifier; omission preserves priority.

description.description: Replacement description text; use an empty string to clear the text.

affiliationId.description: Opaque affiliation identifier to associate; omission preserves the existing affiliation.

remainingSeconds.description: Replacement remaining work in seconds, including zero; omission preserves the current estimate.

scheduledStartAt.description: Replacement scheduled start instant, not actual commencement. Supply whole seconds and Z or an explicit offset; omission preserves the schedule.

changes.description: Partial task changes. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Null is not accepted; empty description clears text, but dates and associations cannot be cleared by this contract.

FunctionInput_accelo_updatetask.description: Identify one existing task and provide only the supported values to replace.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the updated task, unchanged by this operation.

dueAt.description: Due instant in UTC RFC 3339 whole seconds after the update; null or absent if unset.

rateId.description: Opaque billing rate identifier, not edited here; null or absent if unavailable.

standing.description: Task lifecycle standing as reported by Accelo, without collapsing states.

statusId.description: Task status identifier, not directly changed by this tool; null or absent if unavailable.

againstId.description: Opaque unchanged parent-object identifier scoped by againstType; null or absent if unavailable.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC RFC 3339 whole seconds; null or absent if unavailable.

creatorId.description: Opaque creator identifier scoped by creatorType; null or absent if unavailable.

managerId.description: Managing staff identifier after the update; null if none, absent if not supplied.

updatedAt.description: Last modification instant in UTC RFC 3339 whole seconds; null or absent if unavailable.

acceptedAt.description: Acceptance instant in UTC RFC 3339 whole seconds; null or absent if not accepted.

assigneeId.description: Assigned staff identifier after the update; null if unassigned, absent if not supplied.

priorityId.description: Task priority identifier after the update; null or absent if unavailable.

taskTypeId.description: Task type identifier; null or absent if unavailable.

againstType.description: Accelo type of the unchanged attached object; null or absent if unavailable.

commencedAt.description: Actual commencement instant in UTC RFC 3339 whole seconds; null or absent if not commenced.

completedAt.description: Completion instant in UTC RFC 3339 whole seconds; null or absent if not completed.

creatorType.description: Accelo creator object type; null or absent if unavailable.

description.description: Description after the update, preserving empty text, null, and absence distinctly.

rateCharged.description: Exact decimal billing rate, not edited here, without guessed currency or time basis; null or absent if unavailable.

affiliationId.description: Associated affiliation identifier after the update; null or absent if unavailable.

loggedSeconds.description: Total time logged in seconds; null or absent if unavailable.

billableSeconds.description: Billable time logged in seconds; null or absent if unavailable.

budgetedSeconds.description: Budgeted time in seconds as returned by Accelo; no update coupling to remainingSeconds is assumed.

remainingSeconds.description: Remaining work in seconds after the update; null or absent if unavailable.

scheduledStartAt.description: Scheduled start in UTC RFC 3339 whole seconds after the update; null or absent if unset.

nonbillableSeconds.description: Nonbillable time logged in seconds; null or absent if unavailable.

FunctionOutput_accelo_updatetask.description: The updated task reported by Accelo, including available unchanged context.

tags.instructions: Find a task ID with `list-tasks`, or inspect it with `get-task`, then provide only fields to change. Omitted fields stay unchanged; an empty description clears its text. Null clearing of dates and associations is not supported by this contract. This can overwrite existing task values. Use `create-task` for new work. Status progression and changing the attached parent are not supported here. After an uncertain write, inspect `get-task` before retrying.

functions.name: upload-attachment
functions.description: Upload one file to a known collection on a business object, up to 10 MiB per call.

fileName.description: Filename to attach, including any extension; not a filesystem path.

mimeType.description: File MIME type, for example application/pdf.

objectId.description: Identifier of the business object owning the collection.

objectType.description: Accelo collection-owning object route name, for example companies, prospects or quotes; supported values depend on the object.

collectionId.description: Existing collection identifier on that object.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of exact file bytes; decoded size must not exceed 10 MiB (10485760 bytes). Empty string represents a zero-byte file if Accelo accepts it.

FunctionInput_accelo_uploadattachment.description: One file and its existing Accelo business object collection destination.

sizeBytes.description: Acknowledged attachment size in bytes, if returned.

FunctionOutput_accelo_uploadattachment.description: Aggregate attachment acknowledgment from Accelo, without an attachment identifier.

tags.instructions: Provide the business object type/ID and its collection ID from Accelo. Supply exact file bytes as base64, plus filename and MIME type; maximum decoded size is 10 MiB. This adds an attachment, not an import of file contents. Use `list-attachments` to find existing files and `download-attachment` to retrieve bytes. Repeating an upload may create another file.
